story.name: Story
story.line: From one line of idea to a finished film
story.detail: Best when you start with a sentence, a synopsis or a script. AI helps you break it into chapters, design characters and scenes, draw storyboards, add voices and music, and compose the film.

canvas.name: Canvas
canvas.line: Lay ideas out as nodes and wire your own flow
canvas.detail: Best for experimenting and fine control. Text, images, audio and video are cards; draw wires to pass results on. Choose a model and tune the prompt per node — for a single image or clip, character studies, or a multi-step pipeline.

clip.name: Clip
clip.line: Cut what you have into a film you can export
clip.detail: Best when you already have picture and sound. Put files from the canvas, the story room or the asset shelf on a timeline, then cut, add transitions, subtitles, color and music, and export.
